stem: Which line demonstrates the author’s realization that she may have overestimated her abilities?

options.label: F
options.text: But of course what really made me feel like catching the next bus for Arkansas was that in all the offices I managed to invade, not one casting man had looked at me with sudden interest and exclaimed, “That girl has something.”

options.label: G
options.text: Since then I’ve found this inner voice always spoke the truth or made me try to find it for myself.

options.label: H
options.text: No one in my entire family had ever had artistic yearnings, so they looked upon my girlish dreams as a rather silly and impractical phase, which I would surely outgrow and then settle down in Arkansas like my more sensible cousins.

options.label: J
options.text: It tells me no dream is impossible because faith in my inner self will guide me to its fulfillment.
